steps.text: Most procedures open on their own. Those no change in the CRM triggers yet — authorising a new operation, ending a sharing, updating the community's information — open with "New procedure".
steps.title: Open a procedure by hand

steps.text: Pick the procedure from your regulator's catalogue.
steps.title: Type of procedure

steps.text: Submit: OptimCE opens the procedure as a draft and shows its page.
steps.title: Create

steps.text: At the top, the recipient and the one action that matters now. Below, the steps the regulator sets out, each with its legal delay: the current step is highlighted.
steps.title: The procedure page

steps.text: The procedure lists the documents the regulator expects right away, one per member where needed. Each is generated from the CRM or attached as a file; once all are ready, the procedure is ready to send.
steps.title: The documents to provide
